semantics: Suites under a pure-tier directory (see PURE_DIRS in vitest.config.mjs) whose source shows no mock or host import, but which the pure project cannot run. `hostReadByModuleUnderTest`: the production module under test reads the host itself (platform(), workspace roots, the process runtime, the auth program edge) — each fails alone with no fake host installed, deterministically. `shareTerminalState`: Ink renderer suites that leak process terminal state into each other under a shared module registry. Both lists are shrink-only: a module that takes its host as a layer, or a suite that stops sharing process state, leaves the list and its suite runs in `pure` on its own. A listed file that no longer exists fails config load.
